Albania Resort Land Deal Faces Scrutiny Over Alleged Forgery

A businessman involved in selling land for a luxury resort project in Albania, linked to Jared Kushner, is under suspicion for allegedly forging ownership documents. The allegations also include suspicions of money laundering. The development has brought the resort project under legal scrutiny.
